entry.title: New: Resolution 345 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI, DEPARTMENT OF LAND AND NATURAL RESOURCES, DIVISION OF FORESTRY AND WILDLIFE, FOR MUTUAL AID AND PUBLIC SAFETY COORDINATION

Authorizes the Hawaiʻi Fire Department to enter into a mutual aid agreement with the Department of Land and Natural Resources, Division of Forestry and Wildlife, to establish clear working protocols for resource sharing, unified command structures, and coordinated responses in the event of wildfires that exceed either department’s individual capacity.
